qa.consumerRequirement: Use mask.components as a union of convex rectangles; concave contours require a multi-polygon aware clipper.
limitations: Feet show oblique three-toe material; strict side-profile anatomy requires assembled visual review.
Open hen head is a separately generated candidate; do not switch without eye registration.
No image pixels modified; precision masks preserve connected source ownership.

qa.consumerRequirement: Use mask.components as a union of convex rectangles; concave contours require a multi-polygon aware clipper.
limitations: Head and wattle landmarks are manual source estimates, not proven deformed contact.
Nest is three-quarter perspective; review against scene viewpoint.
Crow, laying and combat not visually accepted from source atlas alone.

registration.constraint: Keep a single uniform material pixel scale for both heads; register each state eye to the same world eye. Recompute command center/rect offset and neckRoot from each state landmarks; never reuse old rooster tile1 as the closed crow pose.

layerContract.wattle: root attaches to throat behind beak, not standalone red balloon; closed/open heads already contain wattle so avoid doubling
layerContract.flightFeather: independent hit-event particle with quill pivot, no repeated spawn on seek
layerContract.egg: pelvis/behind-body emergence then nest, bottom pivot after landing
layerContract.nest: floor-bottom anchor; generated three-quarter shallow bowl, not strict orthographic side

qa.consumerRequirement: Use mask.components as a union of convex rectangles; concave contours require a multi-polygon aware clipper.
limitations: New native head width742 vs reference443: use referencePixelsPerSourcePixel; raw image scale is different.
Relative head-neck height is 1.2% larger than reference after equal-width fit; cannot claim exact unchanged source.
Intermediate full heads and source beak openings require actual four-state assembled playback QA.
Use original skull plus registered beak-region material if the full-head identity transition is visible.

registration.eyeConstraint: Each state eye aligns to the original closed-head eye world point. Uniform scale is common for both intermediate states.
registration.rootConstraint: Use each actual neckRoot and existing continuous neck binding; do not keep the old normalized root.
registration.precision: Eye dark-pupil centroid measured in a manual source ROI; other landmarks visually estimated within 4px.

receipt.encodingTiming: captureStream(0) + one requestFrame per immutable PNG bitmap, plus terminal hold; MediaRecorder PTS are real wall-clock and require FFprobe verification

qa.notes: 公母鸡与开合头部为独立真实素材。新场景的源图比例、衔接、蹲姿、嘴型过渡和产蛋遮挡仍在美术复测，本片尚未通过。
